_doc: Bishop line skill definitions (spec #372). Each skill ticket appends its own region of `skills` (separate tickets, separate regions): BS4 Heal (2301002, moved from magician.json); BS5 Holy Arrow (2301005, moved from magician.json), Shining Ray (2311004), Angel Ray (2321007) and Teleport (2301001, moved from magician.json as teleport_cleric); BS6 Genesis (2321008) and Big Bang (2321001, via extends big_bang); BS7 Summon Dragon (2311006) and Bahamut (2321003); BS8 Resurrection (2321006). A pool key with no entry here stays inert: it is never offered or learned.

heal._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses named after the lineage's passives; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.82. Every effect names a stat Heal's rule reads: heal_power and heal_threshold (BS4), area (the undead box) and damage (the undead strike, resolved).
heal.name: Heal
heal.desc: Restores HP below half health, or strikes undead inside its holy box.

text.desc: Recovers your HP when it falls below half, and damages every undead monster in the area.

heal._heal: Tier A: mpCon/hp/lt/rb from v83. Tier B: undead formula; weak historical recovery coefficients. Tier C: provisional choice of the unverified single-target recovery fit (docs/research/cleric-heal.md), below-half trigger (strictly below: a hit exactly at the threshold waits), 2 s recast, every undead in the box, 0.8 s stance, the recovery only for a character below the resolved threshold. BS4 (#376): the undead strike multiplies its bounds by the resolved damage; the default 30-level table gives eight ranks.
